qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Wholesale merchant power generator transitioning from coal/lignite to offshore/onshore wind and solar. Operates as a commodity price-taker on wholesale European electricity markets with zero structural pricing power above spot clearing rates. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~5-6% (2021: 4.4%, 2022: -3.6%, 2023: 8.6%, 2024: 5.9%), failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & merchant commodity pricing, REJECT). RWE operates primarily as an independent power producer and energy trader exposed to wholesale electricity spot market swings. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC is structurally below 6%, falling far short of the 12% hurdle, while heavy renewable capex continuously dilutes returns on capital.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year ROIC averages ~5% over 2021-2024 (4.4% in 2021, -3.6% in 2022, 8.6% in 2023, 5.9% in 2024). Electricity is a non-differentiated commodity price-taker product. Capital expenditure program for green transition requires heavy debt funding without pricing power protection.
